title: About UGC Ecommerce Ad Templates | AIVideosUGC
description: AIVideosUGC makes UGC product photos and video ad templates for a small ecommerce shop. Upload one photo and download a file you can post today.
h1: About AIVideosUGC: UGC Photos and Video Ads
lead: Creators and shoot days slow a small shop down. AIVideosUGC turns a product photo or a product page link into UGC store images and short video ads. Add a presenter, voice, captions, or music, then review the file before you publish.
secondary_keywords: product content tool for Etsy shops

sections.h2: A Mug Photo Becomes the Ad
paras: Start with the ceramic mug photo, or with the product page link. Pick a ready-made look or describe the desk, then make a square store image or a 6, 10, 15, or 30-second video.

The same mug can stay a clean listing photo, or it can become a vertical clip for social. The video may include a presenter, a script, a spoken voice, captions, and music. You read it before anyone else sees the file.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a blonde chin-length bob sets a plain ceramic mug on paper beside a closed laptop.

sections.h2: For Shop Owners at the Packing Table
paras: A clear product photo and one sentence about the scene give you a listing image or an ad. Use the same path for a Shopify, Amazon, or Etsy catalog when the next order is already on the table.

Paste a product page when a listing changes, or make several versions from one photo when the campaign needs a new angle. The editor lets you adjust the words, presenter, voice, and captions before download.
sections.alt: Adult small-shop owner prepares a plain product for a listing at a packing table.

sections.h2: Your Uploads Stay in Your Account
paras: Your uploads and generated files stay in your account and are not shown to other customers. The product photos and drafts you are working on stay in one place, next to the closed laptop.
Use photos you own or have permission to use. Requests involving a celebrity, public figure, or a brand mark you do not own can be declined.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a copper-red low bun sits by a closed laptop and a small brass padlock.

sections.h2: See the Credit Cost Before You Start
paras: Every photo and video shows its credit charge before the job starts. Pick the monthly plan that fits how many files you make.

A product photo uses 24 credits. Video uses 24 credits at 6 seconds, 40 at 10, 60 at 15, or 120 at 30. A failed job returns its reserved credits, and downloads have no watermark. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a short silver crop reviews plain wooden tokens beside a closed laptop.

paras: A photo or a link can become the ad without booking a shoot. Pick from 53 AI actors, or make an AI twin from a photo you have rights to use. A voice you may use can be cloned. The same ad can be made again in another language.
Email support@aivideosugc.com if a job or a file needs a person. Plans stay on the pricing page, and each job still shows its credit charge before it starts.

faq.a: AIVideosUGC makes UGC store images and short video ads from a product photo or a product page link. You use AI actors, a script, and a voice, and you review the file before you download it.

faq.q: Can I make creator-style clips here?
faq.a: Yes. A generated presenter can talk about the product in a creator-style clip. For help with an account, a job, or a file, email support@aivideosugc.com.

faq.q: What are the best uses for AIVideosUGC?
faq.a: Shops use it for video ads, product photos, and social clips. Start with a product photo or a product page link you are allowed to use, then add a short scene description.

faq.q: Can I use AIVideosUGC for marketing?
faq.a: Yes. It is for online sellers and marketers who need product images and short ads from their own catalog. You do not book a studio or a creator for every item.
No. Starter is $24.50 per month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. Each job shows its credit charge before it starts.

faq.q: Can I reuse an AI actor?
faq.a: Yes. You can select an AI actor for a video and change the presenter in the editor. The files and references you create remain in your account.

faq.q: Can a video include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. A video can include a spoken line, captions, and music, and the editor lets you change those elements before download.

faq.q: Can I publish the files on my store or social channels?
faq.a: Yes. Download the file or send it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook, then follow the rules of the channel where you publish. Your own software can also start a job through the API.
